title: The Bidding Games: Reinforcement Learning for MEV Extraction on Polygon Blockchain
abstract: arXiv:2510.14642v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In blockchain networks, the strategic ordering of transactions within blocks has emerged as a significant source of profit extraction, known as Maximal Extractable Value (MEV). The transition from spam-based Priority Gas Auctions (PGA) to structured auction mechanisms like Polygon Atlas has transformed MEV extraction from public bidding wars into sealed-bid competitions under extreme time constraints. While this shift reduces network congestion, it introduces complex strategic challenges where searchers must make optimal bidding decisions within a sub-second window without knowledge of competitor behavior or presence. Traditional equilibrium-based game-theoretic models struggle in this high-frequency, partially observable environment. While auction theory provides equilibrium solutions for sealed-bid formats under incomplete information, these models typically assume known bidder value distributions and stationary competition--

translated_title: 竞价游戏：用于Polygon区块链上MEV提取的强化学习
translated_abstract: 在区块链网络中，区块内交易的策略性排序已成为一种重要的利润提取来源，即最大可提取价值（MEV）。从基于垃圾交易的优先级Gas拍卖（PGA）向结构化拍卖机制（如Polygon Atlas）的转变，将MEV提取从公开竞价战转变为在极端时间限制下的密封投标竞争。虽然这种转变减少了网络拥堵，但它引入了复杂的策略性挑战，搜索者必须在亚秒级窗口内做出最优出价决策，且无法了解竞争对手的行为或存在情况。传统的基于均衡的博弈论模型在这种高频、部分可观测的环境中难以发挥作用。虽然拍卖理论为不完全信息下的密封投标格式提供了均衡解，但这些模型通常假设已知投标者价值分布和静态竞争——这一假设在动态的Polygon生态系统中并不成立。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的强化学习（RL）框架，该框架基于部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）对MEV提取竞价过程进行建模。我们的方法利用近端策略优化（PPO）算法来学习最优竞价策略，该策略能适应动态的竞争环境。我们使用来自Polygon区块链的真实数据评估了我们的框架，证明了其与基准方法相比，能够显著提高MEV提取成功率，同时降低Gas成本。我们的工作为在现实区块链环境中应用RL解决复杂的策略性经济问题提供了首个实际验证。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程和近端策略优化的强化学习框架，用于在Polygon区块链的密封投标MEV提取竞价中学习最优策略，显著提升提取成功率并降低Gas成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning framework based on partially observable Markov decision processes and proximal policy optimization to learn optimal bidding strategies in sealed-bid MEV extraction on Polygon blockchain, significantly improving extraction success rate while reducing gas costs.
